name: meok-bio-lookup-mcp

        Data attribution
        ----------------
        This MCP wraps public APIs:
        
        * PubMed E-utilities — U.S. National Library of Medicine, National Institutes
          of Health. https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/query/static/eutils_help.html
          No API key required; rate limit 3 req/s without API key.
        * ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API — U.S. National Library of Medicine, National
          Institutes of Health. https://clinicaltrials.gov/data-api/about-api
          No API key required; rate limit ~50 req/min.
        
        Use of these APIs does not imply endorsement by NLM/NIH. This MCP performs
        no clinical interpretation — it returns public records verbatim. Downstream
        tools must not present the outputs as medical advice.
